title: Carnegie Mellon launches CS Learn with free full-semester lectures on YouTube
summary: Carnegie Mellon’s Griffin School of Computer Science launched CS Learn, which is publishing full-semester lecture videos from current CMU computer science courses for free on YouTube. Phillip Compeau, who runs the program, said one course premieres each day this week and more will arrive in January, with student-built tools automating much of production. The available topics include ML Systems and probability, and the offering is lecture video rather than a full course package. The launch materials do not state whether assignments and homework will be released, so learners should not assume those materials are included.
